races.name: Yeats Irish Whiskey Claiming Hurdle

runners_data.name: Raydamann
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly positioned behind the lone leader with solid recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Decent form near the end of the season before last, winning a maiden hurdle at Clonmel and placed in a handicap at the Punchestown festival; fair form in handicaps last summer; subsequent form raises doubts.

runners_data.name: Torquay Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has won twice at Sligo but needs luck in running from the back
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner, including on both Sligo visits; has been chasing and went close at Tramore on his penultimate start; strong contender here on the form that brought handicap wins over C&D and at Galway in the first half of last season; rider's 7lb claim an asset.

runners_data.name: Woodstream Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up style returning to form but must overcome traffic from rear position
runners_data.spotlight: Has been inconsistent in recent years; three-time winner; returned to form with a second placing in a similar race at Tramore last month; should go close.

runners_data.name: Hasten Slowly
runners_data.note: Prominent racer suited by tactics but poor recent form is concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Two of her three wins over hurdles have come at Tramore; a long way below her best in a similar race to this at that course in April; hard to fancy following remote seventh behind Rich Belief at Wexford.

runners_data.name: Tomas O Maille
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with terrible strike rate and poor recent efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Only one win from 26 starts over hurdles; a long way below his best in two starts in May; not well treated by the race conditions.

runners_data.name: Eyeeye
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 256-day layoff with warning about fading in finishes
runners_data.spotlight: Low-rated Flat maiden with minor placed form over hurdles; lacks a recent run and is not well suited by the race conditions; others much preferred.

runners_data.name: Jaariam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fit from point-to-points but weak hurdles form
runners_data.spotlight: Fit from a point-to-point campaign; some ability in bumpers in 2022; weak hurdles form.

runners_data.name: Rich Belief
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid rating but inconsistent and needs gaps to appear
runners_data.spotlight: Fair hurdles form in 2022; has done most of his racing on the Flat in recent years; second at Clonmel last September has been the only bright spot in that sphere since a 2024 Chester win; found his level when winning in this category at Wexford 13 days ago; should be the mix again.

runners_data.name: Bocelli's Voice
runners_data.note: Prominent veteran with modest rating facing tough company at age 10
runners_data.spotlight: Weak chase form over the past 12 months; has a modest hurdles rating; veteran faces a stiff task in this company.

runners_data.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners_data.note: Lone leader with poor overall form but significant tactical advantage
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 in points; placed in two small-field maiden hurdles last year; overall form is unconvincing.

races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Arizona will lead from the start with no serious pace pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this field. Raydamann, Hasten Slowly, Jaariam and Bocelli's Voice will track prominently behind the leader, creating a wall of horses that could cause traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up horses Torquay Road, Woodstream Lad, Rich Belief and Eyeeye will need clear runs from the back half of the field. This sustainable early pace followed by congestion in the straight clearly favours the prominent racers who can position just behind the leader and avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and Phoenix Arizona weakens 2 out
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run on the tiring leader while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic. Raydamann or Hasten Slowly can capitalize from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent bunch bunches up and creates a clear outside passage
scenarios.body: One of the better-rated closers can sweep past the congested leaders in the final furlong. Torquay Road's Sligo record makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Phoenix Arizona Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's sustainable pace allows him to kick clear turning in
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets such an easy time that he can find extra reserves when challenged. His modest ability makes this unlikely but the tactical advantage is real.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Arizona goes too slow and the field comes to him in a bunch
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells and the highest-rated horses prevail regardless of position. This scenario requires an unusually dawdling pace.

watchPoints.text: Phoenix Arizona sets a crawling pace that negates the hold-up horses' finishing kick completely
Raydamann and Hasten Slowly clash for the prominent position and compromise each other's chances
The prominent wall of four horses creates a complete traffic jam turning for home
Torquay Road's jumping under pressure given his strong course record but hold-up requirements
Woodstream Lad's stamina holding out at this shorter trip after longer distance efforts

races.name: Stephen Mullins & Sons Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Scathach
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest RPR who should benefit from tactical race shape despite finishing concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Finished in midfield in a strong Leopardstown maiden on debut; remote sixth behind Bambino Fever at Fairyhouse in January, with today's rival Family Way behind; made mistakes and fell two out at Naas in February; tailed off when well-fancied at Wexford last month; too keen then, fair chance now if settling better.

runners_data.name: Crios Cu Chulainn
runners_data.note: Lightly raced type from champion connections but showed little in recent Wexford outing
runners_data.spotlight: Idaho mare out of a half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Faugheen; tailed off on debut in a bumper at Punchestown; moderate seventh at Wexford 13 days ago; no hurdling experience.

runners_data.name: Mia In Milan
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but low ability level, fades badly in finish and lacks competitive pace
runners_data.spotlight: Ran respectably in mid-field in Punchestown festival bumper; never in contention on hurdles debut at Killarney.

runners_data.name: Family Getaway
runners_data.note: Elliott-trained hold-up horse returning from 146-day break, fell when showing promise on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to useful and versatile performer The Very Man; in touch when falling at the third-last on debut in a 2m Cork maiden hurdle last November; out of her depth in maidens won by Oldschool Outlaw and Bambino Fever.

runners_data.name: Tawny Lea
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but poor recent form at this venue suggests insufficient ability for this level
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in maidens at this venue and Limerick last month; not a likely contender.

runners_data.name: Clash Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who took step forward last time, 51 days since last run could be positive
runners_data.spotlight: Mildly promising bumper debut in a 2024 contest won by Bambino Fever, well held in two 2m4f Fairyhouse maiden hurdles; took a small step in the right direction when fifth at Tramore in April; place chance.

runners_data.name: Ellens Pride
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer but jumped badly at Ballinrobe 14 days ago, point winner on soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner on yielding ground for Tim Doyle last November; well beaten in four starts under rules; jumped badly in a maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe a fortnight ago on first start for Sam Curling.

runners_data.name: Bangor Lady
runners_data.note: Only pace angle but poor recent handicap form, trainer had 16-1 winner recently though
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field off a lowly mark in handicap hurdle runs at this venue and Tramore; very hard to make a case for her, though the stable had a 16-1 winner at Punchestown on Saturday.

runners_data.name: Carrigeen Kirkia
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but failed to impact in three bumpers, stout staying pedigree though
runners_data.spotlight: Ordinary form in points; has failed to make any impact in three bumper starts; stout pedigree, dam a point winner and sister to Irish Grand National winner Rogue Angel.

runners_data.name: Cherry Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but failed to complete twice in points since return from 1217-day absence
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden pointer has failed to complete twice in points since return from a long absence; missed an engagement at Puchestown on Sunday.

runners_data.name: Mo Chailin Mor
runners_data.note: Unknown style but beaten 70+ lengths in three hurdle starts, tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten in excess of 70l in three maiden hurdles last winter; chance is not obvious; however, she is in good hands and a tongue-tie may help.

races.paceDynamic: Bangor Lady is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will dictate from the front without pressure. With no other pace angles, she can set a steady tempo through the early stages before quickening approaching the business end. The lack of pace pressure creates a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. This shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, as the uncontested leader will fade and those tracking behind can time their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate and runners are bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Bangor Lady sets steady fractions but weakens approaching the last, allowing patient hold-up types to unleash finishing kicks. The tactical nature rewards horses with turn of foot over pure stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady maintains her gallop to the line and others fail to respond
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and see off challenges, particularly if the field is slow to organize behind her. Her recent consistency gives her an edge in a weak maiden.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses fall or make crucial jumping errors at the business hurdles
scenarios.body: The race falls apart through attrition, allowing an outsider who jumps cleanly to inherit the contest. Inexperienced maidens over hurdles often produce messy contests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Quickens Unexpectedly
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys push forward early to challenge Bangor Lady's lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina rather than tactics, suiting horses with proven staying ability. This scenario requires multiple riders to abandon patient tactics simultaneously.

watchPoints.text: Bangor Lady's jumping under pressure - if she falters at crucial hurdles the race opens up completely
Scathach's finishing kick timing - needs to be produced late to overcome his tendency to fade
Family Getaway's fitness after 146 days off - Elliott horses often need runs but this one showed ability
Early pace development - if others join Bangor Lady early it changes the entire tactical complexion
Clash Gold's jumping rhythm - made progress last time and needs clean leaping to deliver hold-up challenge

races.name: RSS Record Storage Service Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Killowen House
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent third, half-brother to Chantry House gives confidence in ability
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to the talented Chantry House; off the mark at fifth attempt in points at Quakerstown in April; shaped with promise when third behind a stablemate of Koliath De Couely on hurdling debut at Cork; however, that was over a much longer trip; this might not be ideal, fair chance all the same.

runners_data.name: Commodity Broker
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the strong pace scenario, but debut issues at Ballinrobe raise questions about racecourse handling
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty went wrong on debut at Ballinrobe, since he was hampered early and raced a bit keenly, as well as showing a tendency to hang; not disgraced in the circumstances; may improve.

runners_data.name: Goldenkap
runners_data.note: Unraced newcomer with expensive price tag but complete unknown quantity for debut
runners_data.spotlight: A E90,000 Goffs Arkle purchase as a 3yo; tenth foal; half-brother by Kapgarde to six winners, notably Gold Tweet, winner of 11 races over jumps in France; dam 1m2f winner.

runners_data.name: Koliath De Couely
runners_data.note: Willie Mullins newcomer with French form, 366 days off track but quality stable compensates
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a short head a year ago on his only start for the Viel partnership in France; cost E150,000 last July; obvious chance in a race in which not many appeal.

runners_data.name: Rosenborg
runners_data.note: Recent Punchestown run was disappointing, needs significant improvement from lightly-raced profile
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a point; plenty of improvement needed from his run at Punchestown last Saturday.

runners_data.name: Humble Berkshire
runners_data.note: Pulled up on debut at 66-1, hold-up style theoretical only given poor form
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 chance when pulled up first time out at Limerick; safe to rule out.

runners_data.name: The Boysofairhill
runners_data.note: Front-runner from points background, tailed off at Listowel suggests stamina concerns over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner in a confined maiden at Dromahane; tailed off in a bumper at Listowel last week; no hurdling experience.

runners_data.name: Eastwestconnection
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced with fading tendency, pulled up in points suggests limited ability
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in a point; well held by Sampoet on running in a maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe.

runners_data.name: Ballyminnion Boy
runners_data.note: Failed to complete point starts, remote tenth on hurdles debut indicates minimal chance
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete two point-to-point starts; remote tenth at Limerick on hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Hopeful Hero
runners_data.note: Consistent placed form in bumpers and hurdles, 212 days off but prominent style suits pace scenario
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in four of seven bumper starts and in both starts over hurdles; seems to run best on good ground, so any ease in the ground might be a negative; may need this after a break.

runners_data.name: Sampoet
runners_data.note: Veteran with hunter chase experience, recent hurdles debut respectable but needs handicap company
runners_data.spotlight: Is 1-16 in points; placed in hunter chases; not disgraced on recent hurdles debut but likely to need a handicap mark.

runners_data.name: Mc Swagger
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who dropped away tamely at Listowel, frame record in bumpers not translated to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame in two bumper attempts; has yet to reach that standard over hurdles; dropped away tamely at Listowel last time.

runners_data.name: Crystabel
runners_data.note: Front-runner with improved local form, third at this venue suggests handles track well
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown improved form to take third in maidens here and at Ballinrobe; perhaps a little more is needed to make the frame here.

runners_data.name: Lilac Lady
runners_data.note: Local-trained mare with fair placed form here, hold-up style benefits from expected strong pace
runners_data.spotlight: Locally-trained mare; boasts fair placed form at this venue, including second behind a well-fancied rival four weeks ago; has the potential to win a race but likely to find a few too good this time.

runners_data.name: Alentejo
runners_data.note: Modest flat form for Haggas, never threatened on Irish debut suggests limited hurdling ability
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in three Flat maidens for William Haggas in 2024; never threatened at Ballinrobe on Irish/hurdling debut.

runners_data.name: Let's Go La Fichad
runners_data.note: Front-runner with keen tendencies, hooded on hurdles debut but failed to build on Wexford third
runners_data.spotlight: Too keen and tailed off in both bumpers; improved when hooded on hurdles debut at Wexford, although again somewhat headstrong; failed to build on that at Tramore, faded after a bad blunder three out.

races.paceDynamic: The Boysofairhill, Crystabel, and Let's Go La Fichad will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to engage early. The pace will be testing throughout this 2m1½f maiden hurdle, particularly given Let's Go La Fichad's tendency to race too keenly and The Boysofairhill's point-to-point background where he sets the tempo. This relentless gallop will stretch the field and expose stamina limitations, especially in a 16-runner field where positioning becomes crucial. The sustained pace strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina reserves who can benefit from the collapse of pace-setters in the final stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out in the early exchanges
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out several runners, allowing hold-up horses like Commodity Broker, Humble Berkshire, and Mc Swagger to pick up the pieces late. The pace will be too strong for many of the lightly-raced newcomers to handle effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mullins Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Koliath De Couely shows the quality expected from his French form and €150,000 price tag
scenarios.body: Willie Mullins' charge can settle behind the pace and use his class advantage to overcome the strong gallop that will suit his patient style. The combination of proven ability and top connections overcomes the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters proves tougher than expected and maintains the gallop
scenarios.body: Crystabel's recent improved form at this venue could see her handle the pace better than her rivals, particularly with her local knowledge. The sustained tempo plays to her strengths if she can avoid the early burn-out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Hopeful Hero or Killowen House can position perfectly behind the early pace
scenarios.body: Their prominent style allows them to track the strong gallop without getting caught up in the early pace battle, positioning them to strike when the leaders weaken. Both have shown sufficient form to capitalize if the race unfolds ideally.

watchPoints.text: Let's Go La Fichad's keen racing could set an unsustainable pace that compromises all three front-runners
Koliath De Couely returning after 366 days off could need the run despite Mullins' excellent strike-rate
Market support for any of the unraced newcomers Goldenkap or other lightly-exposed runners
Ground conditions remaining genuinely good as several runners have specific going preferences
Early positioning of hold-up horses Commodity Broker and Mc Swagger to avoid traffic problems in large field

races.name: Crawford Tiles And More Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Moulane West
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with local course win but concerning 28-day break and weak recent form at age 10
runners_data.spotlight: Locally-trained gelding won here early last season; overall record is unconvincing and getting on in years; down the field here four weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Hurricane Honey
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 234-day break, better over longer trips but yard debut creates uncertainty
runners_data.spotlight: Went close over fences at this venue last October, seems better over longer distances; makes debut for this yard after a break.

runners_data.name: Mount Ferns
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with headgear applied, pulled up last time and trainer struggling with 0/12 recent record
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles win in 2024 came at Listowel (2m, soft) off 91; returned there last September for a staying-on third in the same event; pulled up at Cork a month ago on reappearance after a winter break.

runners_data.name: Gforcejenny
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner with headgear on, likely to get uncontested lead but yet to win over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a juvenile hurdle at last year's Listowel festival; satisfactory effort when fifth at Down Royal in her first handicap; a likely contender with normal improvement.

runners_data.name: Coole Vision
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 1167 days off, impossible to assess current ability despite handicapper dropping him
runners_data.spotlight: Over four years since his last racecourse start, pulled up in a point-to-point in February.

runners_data.name: Soldier Saint
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, returning from longer distances which may not suit this 2m1½f trip
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a bumper for Nicky Henderson; has shown improvement over longer distances in his two most recent races; return to shorter trip is a concern.

runners_data.name: Avandra
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with first-time blinkers and tongue-tie, recent second at Tramore suggests improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Was having her 18th start when placed for the first time ten days ago; never far from the pace in that 2m Tramore contest; may feature again, but not guaranteed to reverse previous Wexford form with Cholo.

runners_data.name: Saint Peregrine
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 201 days, lost form after promising second here last year
runners_data.spotlight: Lost form after finishing second in a maiden hurdle on this card a year ago; tailed off in a handicap hurdle here last August; has failed to take to chasing.

runners_data.name: Annarubyrose
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheek-pieces, better recent form over longer distances creates trip concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Third in a C&D maiden last year for Gavin Cromwell; fair recent form for this yard, but over longer distances than this at Downpatrick.

runners_data.name: Grennanstown Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 228 days, shown little over hurdles and hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little over hurdles last year; well beaten in two Flat starts this term; no fitness doubts, but hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Timurshah
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won impressively at Clonmel just 4 days ago, trainer having excellent strike-rate
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; weak form last year; a revelation at Clonmel last Friday on his first run for this stable; won with plenty to spare and would seem to have an excellent follow-up opportunity under a mandatory penalty if he gets a run.

runners_data.name: He Who Dares
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, safely held by Avandra at Tramore 10 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Posed no threat when a 25-1 chance at Tramore ten days ago; safely held by Avandra on that running.

runners_data.name: Granlahan
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who fades late, better over longer trips after improved third at Limerick
runners_data.spotlight: Gave an improved display when stepped up to 2m4f at Limerick 12 days ago, promoted a place to third after the winner's disqualification; this trip may be a little shorter than ideal.

runners_data.name: Cholo
runners_data.note: Prominent racer showing promise since return, has edge over Avandra on previous Wexford meeting
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown promise in two starts since returning from a break; has an edge over Avandra on Wexford running, but that rival showed improved form when second at Tramore recently.

runners_data.name: Boston Bobby
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late, may have needed his return run after 52-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Long-priced winner at Down Royal in December; may have needed Bellewstown run in April; trainer probably has a better chance with recent Tramore second Avandra.

runners_data.name: Theanniversary Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who pulled up early at Tramore, back-to-back winner in winter but concerning recent effort
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back winner last November/December at Thurles (2m, good to yielding) and Cork (2m4f, soft to heavy); pulled up early at Tramore ten days ago in a race in which Avandra produced a much-improved performance to take second; may bounce back.

runners_data.name: Sonny Fella
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing blinkers who fades late, failed to complete three of last four races
runners_data.spotlight: Never in the first four in 15 outings, has failed to complete three of his last four races.

runners_data.name: Dark Berkshire
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades late, second reserve with little ability shown in recent starts
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; has shown little; only slight progress since switched to handicaps for his final two starts in 2025.

runners_data.name: Glin Road Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who fades late, third reserve with weak maiden hurdle form but trainer change notable
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; weak form in maiden hurdles; market check advised if he gets a run on handicap debut and first run since his transfer to Charles Byrnes.

races.paceDynamic: Gforcejenny is the only confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner field and should get an uncontested lead with Hurricane Honey, Saint Peregrine, Annarubyrose and Cholo settling prominently behind. The large field of hold-up horses including Timurshah, Moulane West, and Soldier Saint will create traffic problems turning for home as they all look for racing room simultaneously. With one pace-setter facing minimal early pressure over this stamina-testing 2m1½f trip, the race sets up perfectly for prominent racers and those with proven finishing kicks who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Gforcejenny gets soft fractions and maintains her lead turning for home
scenarios.body: She faces minimal pace pressure and can dictate terms throughout, making it difficult for the wall of hold-up horses to close the gap. Prominent racers like Hurricane Honey and Annarubyrose are best placed to capitalize if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear runs and the pace collapses in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Timurshah's recent Clonmel win suggests he has untapped ability, while Moulane West's local knowledge could prove decisive. The lack of early pace allows closers to build momentum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes interference in the home straight creating gaps for those with clear runs
scenarios.body: Horses drawn well or ridden for luck like Avandra and Boston Bobby can exploit the confusion. The trainer P J Rothwell has multiple chances to benefit from tactical riding.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Honey or other prominent racers challenge Gforcejenny early and create stronger fractions
scenarios.body: Both leaders tire dramatically, allowing a mid-division runner with tactical speed to strike. Saint Peregrine's return to form or Cholo's recent promise could be decisive.

watchPoints.text: Timurshah just won at Clonmel 4 days ago and quick turnaround after breakthrough win could signal confidence from in-form trainer Aidan Melia
Hurricane Honey returns after 234-day break making stable debut - market support would be significant given the lengthy absence
Multiple P J Rothwell runners Avandra, Boston Bobby and Dark Berkshire create tactical options with different trip preferences
Gforcejenny as the only front-runner will be closely monitored early - any signs of over-racing could compromise her stamina
Traffic problems are inevitable with 19 runners and 13 hold-up horses - watch for those securing good early positions

races.name: Glasshouse Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: The Dabbler
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent racer back over hurdles after 217 days off, needs to recapture his 2024 course and distance form
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran won over C&D in 2024; has been mostly over fences since during a truncated period and has to bring his best now back hurdling.

runners_data.name: Loyal Praetorian
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest maiden form, unlikely to handle this competitive handicap company
runners_data.spotlight: Some fair runs in maidens including at Limerick last time but was pulled-up on handicap debut two starts ago at Cork; needs his best to figure.

runners_data.name: Sphagnum
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose form collapsed badly after winning Cork National, headgear change suggests desperation
runners_data.spotlight: Lost his form badly after winning the Cork National in 2024 and is hard to fancy on recent poor hurdle runs; blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Brandt
runners_data.note: Hold-up chaser returning to hurdles with limited recent experience in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner has run well at times in defeat over hurdles but only three runs in this sphere in last two years; needs to do more.

runners_data.name: Private Policy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer coming off a gutsy 3m win, up 6lb but lightly-raced and likely still improving
runners_data.spotlight: Battled hard to win at Punchestown last time over 3m, his first score; up 6lb for today and should stay this trip; is lightly-raced for his age and likely still progressing; a player.

runners_data.name: Spellacy's Cross
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who is 0-17 over hurdles but showed solid recent chase form, only 12 days since last run

runners_data.name: Joshua's Daylami
runners_data.note: Front runner whose best form came on heavy ground, returning from year-long absence with poor comeback run

races.paceDynamic: Joshua's Daylami is the only confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field over 3m2f, giving him a significant tactical advantage to dictate terms without early pressure. The Dabbler, Private Policy, and Sphagnum will likely sit prominent, but with most runners adopting hold-up tactics, the pace will be modest through the early stages. This creates a classic scenario where the lone leader can kick clear turning for home while the large field of hold-up horses gets into traffic trouble behind. The sustainable pace and clean jumping opportunities strongly favour the front runner and prominent racers over the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Joshua's Daylami gets an uncontested lead and jumps cleanly
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter builds an insurmountable advantage while the packed field behind struggles for racing room in the straight. Hold-up horses find too much traffic and ground to make up over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If The Dabbler or Private Policy can track the leader and outfinish him
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their tactical speed to close down Joshua's Daylami in the final furlong. Their prominent position avoids the traffic issues that will plague the hold-up horses behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse gets a clear run
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted hold-up horse like Spellacy's Cross finds the gaps and benefits from a truly-run finish. The lack of early pace allows the field to bunch up and creates a sprint finish that suits fresh legs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or the pace is suicidal early
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with jumping errors or pace pressure, allowing a forgotten horse like Ilbdare to benefit from others' misfortunes. Course specialists and those with good jumping records prosper when others fail.

watchPoints.text: Joshua's Daylami could steal this if he jumps fluently in front, as no other confirmed pace-setters will pressure him early
Private Policy's recent Punchestown win was gutsy and the 6lb rise may not stop his progression over this longer trip
The Dabbler's 217-day absence is a major concern for a 13-year-old veteran, despite his previous course and distance success
Spellacy's Cross is 0-17 over hurdles but his recent chase form suggests he's better than that record indicates
Traffic problems are inevitable with 14+ hold-up horses in a 17-runner field, making draw and early positioning crucial

races.paceDynamic: Tradonthebay is the clear pace angle with prominent style and Jack Gilligan's 5lb claim making him handy early. With limited pace pressure in a 19-runner field dominated by hold-up horses, he can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The lack of genuine speed will create a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial, with many hold-up horses needing luck in running. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tradonthebay Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Tradonthebay gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The 5lb claimer can nurse him into the race perfectly and kick when ready, while the hold-up brigade get caught behind the inevitable wall of horses. Prominent runners and those with tactical pace avoid the scramble and benefit from the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large contingent of hold-up horses creates significant interference and bunching
scenarios.body: Many fancied runners get squeezed out or need to switch multiple times, allowing one or two hold-up horses with cleaner passages to emerge. The race becomes a lottery based purely on racing room and positioning luck.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent/midfield runners makes an unexpected mid-race move to challenge Tradonthebay early
scenarios.body: This forces a genuine pace and sets up a staying test that suits the more proven stayers over the longer trip. The tactical race becomes a stamina examination in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Tradonthebay's lack of recent winning form shows and he fades after setting the pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between hold-up horses, but many still get caught up in traffic with only those drawn better or ridden more aggressively able to capitalize. One or two may find clear runs to strike late.

watchPoints.text: Tradonthebay must be monitored for how easily he gets to the front - if there's any early pressure or he's not handy enough, the entire pace dynamic collapses
Steps In The Sand is third reserve but represents major pace threat if getting in - his prominent style and course-winning form could completely alter the race shape
The hold-up horses Clone Cross and Joya Del Mar need watching for clear runs turning in - both have strong recent form but will be sitting in traffic
Love Like This was close second over course and distance last month so track positioning and rider tactics will be crucial for her chances
Joe's Turn as first reserve from the McNiff yard could be very dangerous if declared given his prominent style would help the pace scenario significantly
